settings.text:
Microcurrent is a non-invasive skin treatment that works with the body’s own electrical system to tone and lift the facial muscles. When delivered consistently, microcurrent boosts ATP production which is the energy used in cellular functions. It helps build collagen and increases the skin’s ability to absorb products and nutrients, bringing a refreshed hydrated appearance of the skin.

As with any electrical current device, there are certain precautions that need to be addressed prior to treatment. You will learn about microcurrent safety precautions, contraindications, and protocols used with MyoLift devices.

Read more about our professional microcurrent devices here.
